system.description:
You create a compressed blast of air assisting you in with either a physical tasks or to disperse a hazardous mist or gas.

When making a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution skill check or saving throw you can cast this jutsu to grant yourself a Rank of Master to the check or save.

Alternatively, you can cast this jutsu to instantly dispel a gas or mist within 10 feet of you of a rank equal to or less than the rank this jutsu is cast at.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If cast at B-Rank or higher, you can instead gain 2 ranks of Mastery to the Check. If cast at S-Rank, you instead gain 3 ranks of mastery to the check.
